title: Product strategy
goal: Show a multi-level product strategy map from market focus through measurable execution choices.

rubric.must: Product Strategy is visibly the central root of the map.
Market Focus, Product Bets, Go to Market, and Success Measures visibly branch from the central topic.
Market Focus visibly expands through Ideal Customers and Jobs to Be Done to concrete statements.
Product Bets visibly expands through Core Workflow and Differentiation to named product outcomes.
Success Measures visibly expands to Adoption and Retention with named metrics.
At least three visual levels are distinguishable from root to detailed leaves.

ideal.notes: Drafted by Codex from the source, the rubric and the mindmap/map exemplar, without seeing the engine's own output.

review.evidence: The target shows Product Strategy as the central root, with all four workstreams branching from it. Each workstream has traceable subtopics and leaf details; labels are readable, and nothing appears materially overlapped or cropped.

items.evidence: Product Strategy is centered in the main root node.
Market Focus, Product Bets, Go to Market, and Success Measures each branch visibly from the central topic.
Market Focus branches through Ideal Customers to Mid-market operations teams, and through Jobs to Be Done to Reduce manual coordination.
Product Bets branches through Core Workflow to Faster approvals, and through Differentiation to Explainable automation.
Success Measures branches through Adoption to Weekly active teams, and through Retention to Net revenue retention.
The central root, workstream nodes, subtopic labels, and detailed leaf statements form at least four distinguishable visual levels.
